linux.binding_successor: Qualification metadata uses stable report identities; mutation code is unchanged. The exported binding covers the same sources after release stripping and formatting. The installed-extensions successor admits only the reviewed read-only opened-file identity delegation; native acceptance retains its original measured binding and report. The users reading-limits successor admits only the reviewed reading-limit texts and the streamed CLI read; write limits and write behaviour are unchanged. The users read-only lockless open successor admits only Locking::None in private read-only users::open; write locking and write behaviour are unchanged. The non-Unix write-snapshot lock-classification successor admits only mapping onecd::Error::Locked to SourceBusy in #[cfg(not(unix))] snapshot::load; compiled Unix code and write locking are unchanged.
